description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Regulation made under section 29 read with Section 7 of the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made under the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017, specifically repealing and substituting requirements related to the repatriation of export proceeds. It establishes legal/regulatory frameworks for financial transactions and compliance, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories.
